description: Trigger and behavior evaluation dataset for the isaac-autodata-generate-datasets skill. Positive cases should activate the skill; negative cases should leave it silent.

cases.question: Use Isaac AutoData to generate 10 Franka cube-stacking demonstrations from the annotated dataset and validate the output.
cases.ground_truth: Run generate_dataset.py with --alg mimicgen, --env_name Isaac-Stack-Cube-Franka-IK-Rel-v0, --task_descriptor isaac_autodata_examples/tasks/franka_cube_stack.yaml, --embodiment isaac_autodata_examples/embodiments/franka_ik_rel.yaml, --input_file the annotated Franka dataset, --generation_num_trials 10, then validate with validate_dataset.py.
expected_behavior: Identify a single-arm Franka task and select the mimicgen algorithm.
Use the default container (no cuRobo needed).
Use franka_cube_stack.yaml and franka_ik_rel.yaml as task descriptor and embodiment.
Set --generation_num_trials 10 and a reasonable --num_envs.
Run generate_dataset.py against the annotated Franka source dataset.
Validate the generated HDF5 with validate_dataset.py.

cases.question: I need bimanual pick-and-place demonstrations for the Fourier GR-1 with Isaac AutoData. How do I generate them?
cases.ground_truth: Bimanual coordinated arms require the dexmimicgen algorithm with the gr1 task/embodiment YAML (gr1_pick_place.yaml, gr1_ik_abs.yaml) in the default container.
expected_behavior: Recognize the GR-1 as a bimanual embodiment and select dexmimicgen.
Use gr1_pick_place.yaml and gr1_ik_abs.yaml.
Use the default container (cuRobo not required).
Assemble a generate_dataset.py invocation with --alg dexmimicgen.

cases.question: Make collision-aware Franka bin-stacking trajectories with SkillGen in Isaac AutoData.
cases.ground_truth: SkillGen requires launching the cuRobo container (./docker/run_docker.sh -c) and using the skillgen task/embodiment YAML (franka_bin_stack_skillgen.yaml, franka_ik_rel_skillgen.yaml) with --alg skillgen.
expected_behavior: Select the skillgen algorithm for collision-aware, motion-planned transitions.
State that the cuRobo container (./docker/run_docker.sh -c) is required.
Use franka_bin_stack_skillgen.yaml and franka_ik_rel_skillgen.yaml.
Assemble a generate_dataset.py invocation with --alg skillgen.

cases.question: Add a subtask to my Isaac AutoData franka_cube_stack task descriptor that stacks the green cube on top of the red cube.
cases.ground_truth: Inspect the task descriptor first. Add a well-formed green-on-red subtask only when it is absent; otherwise preserve the existing single final subtask. Any added block must include object_ref, description, nearest_neighbor_object selection_strategy with nn_k, subtask_term_offset_range, action_noise, and interpolation fields, and obey the final-subtask convention (no subtask_term_signal, [0, 0] offset).
expected_behavior: Open the franka_cube_stack task descriptor / example asset and check whether the green-on-red final subtask already exists.
Add the green-on-red subtask only when it is absent; otherwise leave the existing final subtask unchanged.
Use a subtask_term_signal for non-final subtasks and preserve a single final subtask without one.
Keep selection_strategy, action_noise and interpolation fields consistent with siblings when adding the subtask.

cases.question: Train a PPO policy in Isaac Lab on the cartpole task.
cases.ground_truth: This is reinforcement-learning policy training in Isaac Lab, not Isaac AutoData demonstration generation. The skill should stay silent.
expected_behavior: Do not activate the isaac-autodata-generate-datasets skill.
Recognize RL policy training is out of scope.

cases.question: Set up Apple Vision Pro teleoperation for the Unitree G1.
cases.ground_truth: Teleoperation hardware setup is out of scope for this data-generation skill. The skill should stay silent.
expected_behavior: Do not activate the isaac-autodata-generate-datasets skill.
Recognize teleop hardware setup is out of scope.

cases.question: Convert a ROS bag into an HDF5 file.
cases.ground_truth: This is a generic, non-Isaac data pipeline. The skill should stay silent.
expected_behavior: Do not activate the isaac-autodata-generate-datasets skill.
Recognize a non-Isaac data pipeline is out of scope.
